summary: TG Therapeutics filed an 8-K to announce positive Phase 1 clinical trial data for a subcutaneous formulation of ublituximab (BRIUMVI) in relapsing multiple sclerosis. The update includes pharmacokinetic, pharmacodynamic, safety and tolerability results, with no financial terms, acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event. The filing is a routine business update on clinical development, not a change-of-control, tender offer, restructuring, or other event listed in the special-situations framework.
